claim_scope: Research-only source-bound evidence that the O-008 formal cycle records visible necessary claimant-backing checks, bounded ESSO and Lean relations, V1 terminal-domain information loss, a complete twelve-lane feasibility inventory, and the minimum sidecar obligations while keeping O-008 open, all value-movement gates open, and every authority field at NONE.
failure_modes: a bounded theorem or solver result is promoted to O-008 completion
the exact all-twelve-lane reconciliation gap is omitted
a reserve atom is allowed to mask missing claimant backing
the V1 terminal projection is treated as if it retained domain and source principal
a detached host sidecar is assigned verifier or settlement authority
a source hash or exact formal subject drifts while the packet still passes
one of the twelve lanes disappears from the feasibility inventory

aaa.reason: Each checker test arranges one exact packet or one named semantic mutation, invokes the deterministic checker, and asserts the exact machine-readable pass or fail-closed reason.

reject_is_noop.reason: The checker is read-only and produces only a process result and JSON report. It has no state transition, witness constructor, settlement effect, or external effect.

boundary_dimensions.name: claim_ceiling
points: formal cycle complete with bounded claim

boundary_dimensions.name: information_boundary
points: external outbox asset and amount absent

mutations.description: promote the bounded packet to formal-core completion
replace a source pin with a forged digest
remove a lane or sidecar obligation
promote one lane to exact reconciliation completion
repeat a JSON key so a permissive parser could select the unsafe value

nonclaims: The completed formal cycle does not complete O-008 or the formal functional core.
The exact all-twelve-lane claimant and reserve certificate is not implemented, proof-bound, verifier-admitted, or mounted.
The bounded ESSO and Lean results do not establish current runtime refinement, RISC0 receipt validity, Tau parity, publisher admission, or whole-program value safety.
The all-lane audit is a source-data feasibility inventory, not proof that every caller or producer has been exhaustively discovered.
The proposed sidecar has evidence-only authority until it is emitted and bound by the accepted proof fabric.
No production, release, settlement, verifier, migration, publication, or value-moving authority is granted.
